findings.evidence: grep `asymptoticSumTerms` in Pseudodifferential/: the only general lemma is `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms` at AsymptoticSum.lean:705; Adjoint/Classical.lean:140 and Composition/Classical.lean:120 both expand it by hand.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms_zero (c) (z) : (asymptoticSumTerms c 0).coefficient z = ((c 0).term 0).coefficient z`, or the equivalent `asymptoticSumTerms_zero` stated with `castDegree`, next to `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms`.
findings.issue: `asymptoticSumTerms` has only `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms` (not simp), with no general degree-0 lemma, although the leading term of an asymptotic sum is its main use. Callers have to unfold the `range 1` sum each time; `principal_adjoint` and `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms_sharpTerm_zero` both run `simp [coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms, …]`.

findings.evidence: grep `asymptoticSumTerms_sharpTerm_zero` finds only its own declaration at Composition/Classical.lean:116; Adjoint/Classical.lean has no `adjointTerm` counterpart.
findings.fix: With the general `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms_zero` added, delete this lemma, or keep it non-simp and prove it from the general lemma and `sharpTerm_zero`. Nothing else in the repo uses it.
findings.issue: `coefficient_asymptoticSumTerms_sharpTerm_zero` is a `@[simp]` special case of the general degree-0 fact for one family (`sharpTerm`). The adjoint has no parallel lemma, so the API is asymmetric and the simp set has a lemma that a general one plus `sharpTerm_zero` would cover.

summary: The new `ofAsymptoticSum`/`asymptoticSumTerms` API lacks a general characteristic lemma for its leading term, and a composition-only special case is exported as `@[simp]` in its place.
